assembly.sequence.summary: Order parts from a rigid dependency graph with phases, removed parts and disconnected media; flexible media are disconnection prerequisites, never assembly joints.

inputs.parts: Nonempty array of unique part names.
inputs.dependencies: Array of [prerequisite, dependent] pairs: prerequisite is assembled before dependent.
inputs.removedParts: Array of part names to disassemble/service; removal order is reverse of assembly order.
inputs.disconnectedMedia: Array of {name, connects:[a,b], rigid?:bool}; media are disconnection prerequisites, never rigid joints (rigid defaults false).
inputs.phases: Array of {name, parts:[...]} grouping parts into assembly phases; each part in at most one phase.

limitations: Flexible media (wires/hoses) are never rigidized into assembly joints; they only require disconnection. An exploded endpoint is not a feasible insertion path; swept-access feasibility belongs to service.path-check, not the dependency graph.

service.path-check.summary: Sample a swept withdrawal of a part outline in a declared plane and report clearances and blockers; an exploded endpoint is not a feasible insertion path.

inputs.part: Object {name?, outline:[[x,y],...]} cross-section polygon in the withdrawal plane.
inputs.direction: Two finite unitless numbers [dx,dy] giving the withdrawal direction in the plane.
inputs.obstacles: Array of {name?, outline:[[x,y],...], span?:[start,end]} obstacle polygons; span limits where along the withdrawal the obstacle is present.
inputs.samples: Positive integer number of swept-access stations, default 20.

limitations: Swept access is sampled along a straight withdrawal in a declared plane; it is bounds, not a continuous collision proof. A full 3D rigid-body swept check against native bodies is a separate gate.

tool.access.summary: Sweep a cylindrical tool envelope along an approach axis to a fastener and report reach, engagement and blockers; the cylinder is a simplification, not a fingers/grip model.

inputs.tool: Object {diameter, length} cylindrical envelope; length must reach the engagement point.
inputs.target: Object {origin, axis, engagementDepth?} fastener seat; the tool tip must reach origin + axis*engagementDepth.
inputs.entry: Object {origin, direction} tool access point and approach direction.
inputs.obstacles: Array of {name?, point:[x,y,z], radius?} or {name?, box:{min,max}} obstacles near the tool path.
inputs.samples: Positive integer number of swept-access stations, default 20.

limitations: A cylindrical tool envelope is a simplification, not a full fingers/grip model. Reach and engagement are geometric; torque, grip and seating forces are not computed.

fixture.access.summary: Check that a part can seat onto fixture datums: pin/hole diameter fit, datum coincidence and approach reach with explicit prerequisites and blockers.

inputs.part: Object {name?, features:[{name,kind,origin,direction?,diameter?}]}; kind is pin, hole or datum.
inputs.fixture: Object {name?, approach:{direction}, features:[...]}; approach is the seating direction.
inputs.pairs: Nonempty array of [partFeature, fixtureFeature] mating pairs.
inputs.tolerance: Nonnegative length expression for datum coincidence, default 0.01 mm.
inputs.angleTolerance: Nonnegative angle expression for axis/datum alignment, default 1 deg.
inputs.clearance: Nonnegative radial clearance required for a pin-in-hole fit, default 0 mm.

limitations: Seating is a declared-datum geometric check, not a native fixture/part collision solve. Prerequisites (missing features, undeclared diameters) are reported as blockers, not silently filled.
